counter_meaning: The primary coefficient counter measures K*(K+1)/2 retained-coefficient multiply-adds per convolution. NumPy evaluates the full convolution before truncating.
reason: Each equal-length K convolution has K^2 products, and K^2 <= 2*K*(K+1)/2. The primary counts every recurrence convolution and all eight block-composition convolutions per mode/control.
limits: Bound covers these convolution products only, not all matrix operations, transcendental evaluations, runtime or measured CPU instructions. No rerun or tolerance change.
